message:
Slim controls; icon toolbar for student list filters

- Tighten shared .btn/.input/.select sizing so every control is more
  compact platform-wide.
- Replace the student list's boxy toggle + search + dropdowns with a round
  icon toolbar: magnifier expands into a pill search field, sliders open a
  filters popover (active-state dot + clear), archive icon toggles the view.
- Add reusable Segmented control and IconButton; add "filters" i18n string.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
